contractSignals.pattern: \b(agreement|hereinafter|hereby|witnesseth|the parties|effective date|shall not|governing law|in witness whereof)\b

missingClauses.title: Missing: {label}
missingClauses.description: No {label_lower} was detected in this document. Consider verifying whether this protection is covered elsewhere or should be added.

detected.title: Automatic renewal clause detected
detected.description: This document automatically renews unless action is taken. Confirm the opt-out notice window and calendar it.

short.title: Short auto-renewal opt-out window
short.description: Auto-renewal requires only {days} days' written notice to cancel, below the commonly recommended {min_days}-day minimum.

missing.title: Auto-renewal with no clear opt-out notice period
missing.description: An auto-renewal clause was found but no explicit notice period (e.g. 'written notice of 30 days') could be identified.

net.title: Unusually long payment term (Net {days})
net.description: Payment terms of Net {days} exceed the common {max_days}-day threshold, which may strain cash flow.

upfront.title: Full payment required in advance
upfront.description: This document requires full payment upfront, which is less favorable than milestone- or delivery-based payment terms.

jurisdiction.title: Conflicting governing law / jurisdiction clauses
jurisdiction.description: Multiple different governing-law jurisdictions were found in this document: {names}. This may indicate conflicting or copy-pasted clauses that need legal review.
